$comment: 11.8: web props a native twin leaves out on purpose, with the reason. scripts/parity.mjs moves them from webOnly to onPurpose, so webOnly lists only real gaps. A prop listed here that native gains, or that web drops, fails `parity.mjs --check`.

button.reason: asChild renders into another DOM element; magnetic follows the pointer. Neither exists on a touch screen.

card.reason: asChild renders into another DOM element; effect is a pointer hover effect; accent is the marketing showcase edge from @nexub/themes, which has no native build.

icon-button.reason: No hover on phones: the label is the accessibility label, and long-press shows it (Tooltip).

link.reason: asChild renders into another DOM element.

number-ticker.reason: Native announces with accessibilityLiveRegion, set by the component.

multi-select.reason: On native the options always open in a BottomSheet; web's sheet prop opts into that on small screens. virtualizeAbove (12.1) windows the web list; the native list is a FlatList, which always renders only the rows in view.

phone-input.reason: On native the country list always opens in a BottomSheet.

date-picker.reason: Native always opens the platform picker or a sheet; typing a date into a phone field is slower than picking it.

drawer.reason: Browser mechanics of the web drawer (DOM container, body scroll lock, background scaling, input repositioning). BottomSheet is always modal, always from the bottom, and keyboard-aware.

data-table.reason: DataList shows one row per record with its key fields (title, value accessors), not columns, so column layout does not apply; FlatList virtualizes and the screen scrolls.

notification-item.reason: The native twin is the whole inbox: each NotificationEntry carries title, body, time, unread and icon, and onPress selects one.

plan-card.reason: The native twin is the whole paywall: each Plan carries name, price, features and badge, and one Subscribe button (onSubscribe) acts on the chosen plan.

settings-section.reason: The native twin is the whole settings screen: each group has a header and its items.

auth-card.reason: SignInScreen builds its own form (email, password, biometrics).

conversation.reason: ChatScreen is a full screen with its own message list and composer, sized by the screen.

sortable.reason: SortableList takes items with keyExtractor and title, like FlatList, instead of rendered children.

search-input.reason: SearchField always shows the platform clear button while it has text.

time-picker.reason: The time is picked, not typed, so there is nothing to count.

date-time-picker.reason: Native always opens the platform picker or a sheet.

inline-edit.reason: as picks the HTML element the text renders as; native text has no element type.

form-field.reason: React Native has no form submission, so a field has no name to submit under.

currency-select.reason: DOM attributes and form names have no native meaning (the label, error and hint are accessibility props); the list always opens in a sheet, which has no search box. virtualizeAbove (12.1) windows the web list; the native list is a FlatList, which always renders only the rows in view.

event-calendar.reason: Both shape the month and week grids, which native leaves out: a phone shows the day and agenda views.
